title: Redacting selected text
blurb: Select part of a letter and the canvas covers it with a bar, large pixels, a blur or changing letters. A table shows where the covered text can still be read (the DOM, copy) until it is removed from the DOM as well.
question: What does a redaction drawn by a canvas hide, and what still holds the text?
result: It hides pixels only. The DOM, copy and anything that reads the DOM still have the text.
